scope: Generated logic pilot; owned insertions and F01 only; unrelated sources remain pending review.

shared_fragments.text: **生成条件与逻辑规则 / Generated logical rules，2026-10-08。** [本轮理论](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md)给出上下文相容条件下的收缩充要判据、对象演算对应及有限供给精确界限；38项新 Lean 定理／65项总审计通过。/ Sequential reuse, paid replacement and ordinary contraction are separated, with interference and exhaustion controls. Immediate readiness may form while unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. [来源与反审](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/GENERATED-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md)完成首轮可行性检验；新逻辑基础与前沿新颖性未建立。Next: warranted readiness/context contracts and faithful abstraction, compared with existing resource logics.

**生成条件与逻辑规则 / Generative conditions and logical rules，2026-10-08。** [当前结果](unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md)以既有过程核心检验收缩可容许性：38项新 Lean 定理通过，精确区分带成本替代、顺序复用、即时就绪及上下文干扰。/ The conditional pilot is complete, with no claim to derive the metatheory or establish mathematical novelty. The next connection concerns independently warranted readiness and shared contexts, including comparison with Iris/Leaf and graded logic.

**生成逻辑首轮 / Generated-logic pilot，2026-10-08。** [证明、来源与作者反审](GENERATED-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md)记录收缩的上下文／复制判据、有限供给界限及顺序／干扰反例；38项新定理，27项继承审计。/ Readiness formation is distinguished from already reachable preparation. The completed conditional interface does not establish a universal logic or frontier novelty; no independent-agent review is claimed.

**Generated contraction, 8 October 2026.** [GeneratedContraction.lean](GeneratedContraction.lean) adds 14 theorems and [ContractionMechanisms.lean](ContractionMechanisms.lean) adds 24. The isolated [checker](check_generated_contraction.py) passes 65 audits: 51 empty; the other 14 use only propext or propext/Quot.sound. [Integration](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/GENERATED-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md) states the object-calculus correspondence, exact paid budget, serial/contextual controls and readiness correction. No new logical foundation or novelty claim.

**生成逻辑研究原话 / Generative-logic inquiry，2026-10-08。** [本次记录](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-logic-investigation.md)保存Ren关于标准逻辑公理与前沿的提问及“继续”。/ Exact user messages and the AI-authored scope summary are distinguished; [the research record](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/GENERATED-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md) credits primary logical precedents.

**生成条件与逻辑规则 / Generated logical rules，2026-10-08。** F01成对接入[理论](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md)及[证明、来源和反审](GENERATED-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md)：38项新定理／65项总审计，51空依赖；付费替代、顺序复用、上下文相容及即时就绪分别说明。/ Only F01 additions, authored sources and its canonical rendered row are updated. All unrelated entries, generated lines and pending shared reviews are preserved. [Owned edits](GENERATED-LOGIC-INDEX-EDITS.json); [scoped checks](GENERATED-LOGIC-CHECKS.json). No full-table certification, independent-agent acceptance, automation or catalogue rebuild.

entry_before.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
entry_before.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。
entry_before.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction.
entry_before.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。
entry_before.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained.

entry_after.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
entry_after.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。
entry_after.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound.
entry_after.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑或确立前沿新颖性；共享上下文、及时性与忠实抽象待继续比较。
entry_after.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic and novelty are not established; shared contexts, timeliness and faithful abstraction remain for comparison.
